subject: Aurora Finance: request for recovery playbook and RTO/RPO evidence

Cc: security@aurorafin.com
Date: 2026-08-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor intake: BCP/DR evidence request for Aurora Finance

Hannah,

Aurora's vendor security team is kicking off a brief review ahead of our quarterly third-party audit. Could you please provide the following by EOD Friday for our reviewers?

- Latest disaster recovery (DR) / business continuity (BCP) playbook (redacted as needed)
- Measured RTO and RPO figures for production services and for cross-region failover
- Evidence of the most recent DR test (date, scope, summary results)
- Any attestation/statement your security team can sign for our audit packet

If some items require a short lead time, let us know a realistic delivery date. I'm copying security@aurorafin.com for tracking.

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
Head of Vendor Risk
Aurora Finance

Tom — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to support Aurora's audit. Attached to this message I am sharing an initial package with the items you requested:

- redwood_recovery_playbook_v2.pdf (Recovery playbook, redacted operational contact details)
- rto_rpo_metrics_2026-06.csv (Measured RTO/RPO by service, last three DR exercises)
- dr_test_summary_2026-04.pdf (Executive summary of April 2026 cross-region failover test)

Notes / next steps:
- The playbook has operational contact redactions; if auditors need full contact lists we can provide those under an NDA or via secure portal.
- RTO/RPO in the CSV are measured from end-to-end production failover runs; see the header row for methodology brief.
- If you need a signed attestation, I've attached our standard attestation template and can get this executed by our Head of Security. Please confirm the exact text or signatory name you require.

Dylan & Marissa — I've looped you in because we may need Marissa's DR logs export and Dylan's help with the attestation signature flow (internal approvals).

Attaching the initial package now. If anything is missing, flag it and we'll follow up quickly.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Hannah — received, thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of follow-ups from our audit lead: 

1) Can you confirm the RTO for cross-region failover when both primary and secondary regions experience progressive load? We need the operational RTO you observed during the April test (not just the target).

2) Please confirm whether Redwood has an executive-signed attestation available, or if the Head of Security signature will suffice. Our auditors prefer an executive-level attestation but can accept Head of Security with an accompanying SLT note.

If you can provide the redacted logs and the signed attestation by Wednesday EOD, that should keep us on schedule for our audit next week. Also — if there's a secure portal or SFTP preferred for logs, let us know.

Appreciate it — Tom
